prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is visible, move to it, grab it, check its properties and perform specific task. Else, search, move to or scan area until object found.     list of available nodes: <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = SearchForObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToArea    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			SEQUENCE
				DO MoveToObject
				DO GrabObject
				DO CheckObjectProperties
				DO SpecificTask
			END
	END
